mapper.insert: insert into build_ownership(build_id, environment_id, tenant_id) select build_id, environment_id, tenant_id from environment_build_submission where not is_deleted and tenant_id = #{tenant} and actor_id = #{actor} and idempotency_key = #{key} on conflict(build_id) do update set build_id = excluded.build_id where not build_ownership.is_deleted and build_ownership.environment_id = excluded.environment_id and build_ownership.tenant_id = excluded.tenant_id

insert into asset_build_scope(tenant_id, build_id, environment_id, repository, branch_name) select tenant_id, build_id, environment_id, request->>'repository', request->>'branchName' from environment_build_submission where not is_deleted and tenant_id = #{tenant} and actor_id = #{actor} and idempotency_key = #{key} on conflict(tenant_id, build_id) do update set build_id = excluded.build_id where not asset_build_scope.is_deleted and (asset_build_scope.environment_id, asset_build_scope.repository, asset_build_scope.branch_name) = (excluded.environment_id, excluded.repository, excluded.branch_name)
